components.name: Today Docket
components.description: Thermal paper slip with live mono print; high priority prints red.
components.css: .ds-docket { width: 220px; padding: 18px 26px 14px 19px; background: #fbfbf8; color: #121212; font-family: 'Iosevka Charon Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; border-radius: 2px; border-top: 1px dashed #c4c4c4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.07); line-height: 1; } .ds-dk-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 19.5px; color: #b3161b; } .ds-dk-title { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 21.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #b3161b; } .ds-dk-dash { margin: 10px 0; font-size: 15.5px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dk-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 15.5px; }

components.name: Plan Block
components.description: Task on the timeline: white, hairline, mono.
components.css: .ds-block { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 56px; padding-left: 19px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c4c4c4; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Iosevka Charon Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16.5px; color: #111; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-time { width: 71px; } .ds-block:hover { border-color: #5f5f5f; }

components.name: Quick Add
components.css: .ds-quickadd { width: 420px; height: 50px; padding: 0 19px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c4c4c4; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Iosevka Charon Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 20.5px; color: #111; caret-color: #d7261e; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-quickadd:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #5f5f5f; }

components.name: Parsed Chip
components.description: Parsed token under quick add; the high variant is red.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px 0 13px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c4c4c4; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Iosevka Charon Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 17.5px; color: #3c3c3c; } .ds-chip-high { color: #b3161b; border-color: #f2d4d2; }

components.name: Preset Tabs
components.description: Capture, Plan, Focus; active is bold with an ink underline.
components.css: .ds-presets { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-family: Carlito, Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: #3c3c3c; } .ds-presets button { position: relative; background: none; border: 0; padding: 6px 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-presets button:hover { color: #111; } .ds-presets .on { color: #111; font-weight: 700; } .ds-presets .on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -10px; height: 2.5px; background: #111; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-presets button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Save Button
components.css: .ds-save { padding: 9px 16px; font-family: Carlito, Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; background: #111; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #111; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The day is a working kitchen pass. Tasks are paper dockets that come up on a steel ticket rail, get fired onto the line (the timeline) at a time, and are bumped when done. The ground is white and near-white, the ink is near-black, and the only colours are signals: docket red for high priority or carried, bump green for done. Times, durations and counts are set in a tabular monospace as if printed by a ticket machine.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome ground; red and green are signals, never decoration.
Dockets are illustrated paper with live type printed on top.
Mono for every time, duration, count and print line; a humanist sans for chrome labels.
Hairline rules and dashed hour lines; soft, small shadows only.
Motion is first-class, on one shared spring, always with a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red means high priority, carried over, now, or error; green means done. Neither is decoration or a plain action colour.

rules.name: The Paper Never Inverts Rule
rules.body: Printed slips keep paper and print colours in both themes; only the room around them changes.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any time, duration, count or span is set in the print mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Printed Capitals Rule
rules.body: Capitals are used where the paper would print them: docket titles and docket field names, not UI labels.

rules.name: The Lifted-Only Rule
rules.body: Beyond the 1px resting hint, a shadow means the thing is above the surface right now.

dos: Do size anything on the stage in comp px times --u, and take colours from the custom properties.
Do set times, durations and counts in the print mono with tabular figures.
Do keep red and green to their signal meanings.
Do keep dockets as paper with live print on top; update the print, not the plate.
Do give every new animation the shared spring and a reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep a visible focus ring (2px ink, 2px offset) on every control.
donts: Don't replace dockets with card-on-grey list rows, or the rail with a checklist.
Don't invert the paper in dark mode.
Don't add explainer copy; help lives behind the shortcut sheet.
Don't use shadows for decoration at rest.
Don't introduce a third signal colour.
